notes: Expected shared-prior misreads to reconcile hardest: (1) THE STUN-IMMUNITY GATE — the classic trap is dropping 'Gains immunity to Stun' as defensive/no-damage; here it is the load-bearing gate window for the burst's Full Burst Duration ▲5.04s, and the interplay with the 98.56% gauge prefill means exactly the FIRST Full Burst gets extended (first burst lands in the opening seconds, well inside 36.95s; the second, ≥40s cd later, lands outside it). An ungated fullBurstExtend over-credits ~5s of FB uptime on every rotation; a dropped one under-credits the first. The gate is expressible in the schema (e.g. a resource window: init 1 at start, one-shot decrement at ~36.95s via interval, resourceGate min 1 on the burst block) — GAP is not an acceptable disposition. (2) Both Elemental Advantage Attack Damage lines are elemAdvantageDamagePct, never generic attackDamagePct — d is Wind and the controlComp boss is Fire (Fire beats Wind), so the faithful encoding is provably INERT in the fixture; assert via buffApply events plus a zeroed-buff totals-identity check, and if CompOptions permits a boss-element override, add one damage-delta run vs an Iron boss (Wind-advantaged) to pin the bucket live. (3) Burst-cast semantics: the 426.24% nuke and the FB extension key to d's OWN burstCast; helm is a co-B3 in controlComp, so burstCast vs fullBurstEnter genuinely diverge — tests must count d's burstCast events separately from fullBurstStart events. The nuke is FB-exempt (lands pre-window; fbMajorApplied false). (4) The gauge fill is an instant once-per-battle fillGauge, not a burstGenPct rate buff — assert first-FB timing shift plus exactly-one application. (5) Damage to Parts stays partsDamagePct (inert on the partless boss) with alliesOfClass Attacker targeting — verify bit-identical totals with the line removed. (6) The two self-lifesteal lines are honestly UNMODELED (no HP pool, self-targeted); but if the driver encoded them as 'heal' effects, the target MUST be self only — crown sits in the fixture with an on-recovery consumer, and an ally mis-scope would spuriously pump her recovery-triggered buffs every Full Burst.
